_comment: Shared config for review_console.html and review_server/. Add a language here and it appears in the console's dropdown with no code changes — no redeploy needed if this file is served alongside the HTML.
_target_repo_template_comment: Informational only, for the label shown before the backend confirms it — the backend's own TARGET_REPO_TEMPLATE env var is the real source of truth (set once on Render; keep this in sync with it by hand). Each language gets its OWN repo, e.g. voicedata/9jalingo-reviewed-pidgin, voicedata/9jalingo-reviewed-igbo.
_comment_naijavoices: hausa-batch-0/1/2 below are a DIFFERENT source dataset from `hausa` above (naijavoices/naijavoices-dataset, not voicedata/final_hausa) that has multiple SUBSETS -- HF's dataset-viewer calls this the 'Subset' dropdown; our `config` field is the same thing. Each subset gets its own key -> its own reviewed-output repo via TARGET_REPO_TEMPLATE, e.g. voicedata/9jalingo-reviewed-hausa-batch-0.

igbo._private_comment: Private/gated source dataset — the console routes row+audio fetches through the backend (which holds an authenticated token) instead of calling Hugging Face directly from the browser. Requires a server URL to be set in the Sync panel; browsing this language with no backend configured will fail with a 401.
